title: ChestSorter
description: A lightweight utility mod that adds smart chest sorting, quick item transfer buttons, and an intuitive interface.
body:
Chest Organizer
Keep your storage clean and organized with a single click!

Are you tired of cluttered chests? Chest Organizer is a lightweight, easy-to-use mod that brings an automatic sorting system to your Minecraft storage. Whether you're a builder or a casual player, this mod helps you spend less time managing items and more time playing.

Features
One-Click Sorting: Sort your entire chest with just one button.

Customizable Rules: (Optional: mention if you have specific sorting options, e.g., "Sort by type" or "Sort by name").

Lightweight: Designed to run smoothly without impacting your game's performance.

Compatibility: Works seamlessly with standard storage blocks.

How to use
Open any chest or barrel.

Look for the [Sort Button/Hotkey] added by the mod.

Click it, and watch your items get organized instantly!

Support & Feedback
If you encounter any bugs or have ideas for new features, please join our community or report them on the [GitHub/Issue Tracker Link]. Your feedback is always appreciated!
